description_html:
This top floor two/ three bedroom triplex is rare to the market, with views over the Barbican lake. Type109. Starting on the top floor is a large living space, with a barrel vaulted ceiling and a wall of windows/ door leading to a west facing balcony which floods the room with light, there is an open plan kitchen on the floor below with a dining/ living space, a wc on the half landing, with steps down to the fifth floor with two bedrooms and a bathroom. Approx 1260sqft

Willoughby House is conveniently located close to Moorgate and Liverpool Street station with access to the Elizabeth line.

Tenure: Leasehold Lease Years Remaining: 170
Service Charge: £9,065
Annual Ground Rent: £0
Council Tax Band: G
